name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 10 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
